facts.statement: Petrobrasaurus is a titanosaur that lived during the upper Cretaceous period in what is now Patagonia, Argentina.
facts.quote: It is a titanosaur which lived during the upper Cretaceous period (Coniacian-Santonian age) in what is now Rincón de los Sauces, Patagonia, Argentina.

facts.statement: The genus Petrobrasaurus was named by Filippi et al. in 2011.
facts.quote: This genus was named by Leonardo S. Filippi, José Ignacio Canudo, Leonardo J. Salgado, Alberto C. Garrido, Rodolfo A. Garcia, Ignacio A. Cerda and Alejandro Otero in 2011

facts.statement: The genus is known from a partial disarticulated skeleton found in the Plottier Formation of Argentina.
facts.quote: It is known from the holotype MAU-Pv-PH-449 — a partial disarticulated skeleton recovered from the Plottier Formation (Neuquén Basin), Argentina.

facts.statement: The generic name combines "Petrobras", an oil company, with the Greek word for lizard.
facts.quote: The generic name is derived from "Petrobras" (oil company) and saurus, "lizard".

facts.statement: Petrobrasaurus lived between 89.8 and 83.6 million years ago during the Coniacian to Santonian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Coniacian to Santonian (89.8 to 83.6 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Petrobrasaurus is a genus of herbivorous sauropod dinosaur.
rejected.quote: Petrobrasaurus is a genus of herbivorous sauropod dinosaur.

rejected.statement: The specific name refers to the Puesto Hernández oil field where the fossils were discovered.
